//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-3311
//  Prior Week + Daily Range + Countdown + Weekly Summary
//  Prior week H/L/C, Daily range used, Candle countdown timer, Weekly analysis template
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-3311 · Prior Week + Daily Range + Countdown + Weekly Summary", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st3_on   = input.bool(true,      "Show prior week H/L/C",        group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cHi  = input.color(#c9a84c,  "High",  inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cLo  = input.color(#00abff,  "Low",   inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cCl  = input.color(#9aa0a6,  "Close", inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")

[st3_h, st3_l, st3_c] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [high[1], low[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st3_on ? st3_h : na, "PW High",  color = st3_cHi, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_l : na, "PW Low",   color = st3_cLo, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_c : na, "PW Close", color = st3_cCl, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
mn3_on   = input.bool(true, "Show daily range", group = "Main · Daily range", tooltip = "Compares how far price has travelled today against a typical day. Under 100% means today has moved less than average, so there may still be room left in the session. Over 100% means today has already moved further than a normal day.")
mn3_days = input.int(20,    "Compare against last (days)", minval = 2, group = "Main · Daily range", tooltip = "How many previous days are averaged to define a normal day's range.")
mn3_quiet = input.int(60,   "Quiet below %",    minval = 1, group = "Main · Daily range")
mn3_ext   = input.int(110,  "Extended above %", minval = 1, group = "Main · Daily range")
mn3_sz   = input.string("Tiny", "Range table text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Main · Daily range")
mn3_pos  = input.string("Top right", "Range table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Main · Daily range")

mn3_avg  = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", ta.sma(high - low, mn3_days)[1], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
[mn3_dh, mn3_dl] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D", [high, low], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

mn3_today = mn3_dh - mn3_dl
mn3_pct   = mn3_avg > 0 ? 100.0 * mn3_today / mn3_avg : 0.0
mn3_word  = mn3_pct < mn3_quiet ? "QUIET" : mn3_pct > mn3_ext ? "EXTENDED" : "NORMAL"
mn3_col   = mn3_pct < mn3_quiet ? #9aa0a6 : mn3_pct > mn3_ext ? #d27050 : #00abff

mn3_size = mn3_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : mn3_sz == "Small" ? size.small : mn3_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large
mn3_where = mn3_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : mn3_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : mn3_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table mn3_t = table.new(mn3_where, 2, 4, border_width = 0)
mn3_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(mn3_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn3_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = mn3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if mn3_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(mn3_t, 0, 0, "DAILY RANGE", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = mn3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn3_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    mn3_row(1, "Today so far",  str.tostring(mn3_today, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    mn3_row(2, "Normal day",    str.tostring(mn3_avg,   format.mintick), #9aa0a6)
    mn3_row(3, mn3_word,        str.tostring(mn3_pct, "#") + "% of normal", mn3_col)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
sd1_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show candle countdown", group = "Side · Countdown")
sd1_col = input.color(#c9a84c, "Countdown colour",      group = "Side · Countdown")
sd1_sz  = input.string("Small", "Countdown size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large", "Huge"], group = "Side · Countdown")

sd1_size = sd1_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : sd1_sz == "Small" ? size.small : sd1_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : sd1_sz == "Large" ? size.large : size.huge

sd1_left = time_close - timenow
sd1_secs = math.max(0, math.floor(sd1_left / 1000))
sd1_h    = math.floor(sd1_secs / 3600)
sd1_m    = math.floor((sd1_secs % 3600) / 60)
sd1_s    = sd1_secs % 60
sd1_pad(v) =>
    v < 10 ? "0" + str.tostring(v) : str.tostring(v)
sd1_txt = (sd1_h > 0 ? sd1_pad(sd1_h) + ":" : "") + sd1_pad(sd1_m) + ":" + sd1_pad(sd1_s)

var label sd1_lbl = na
if sd1_on and barstate.islast
    label.delete(sd1_lbl)
    sd1_lbl := label.new(bar_index + 2, close, sd1_txt, style = label.style_label_left, color = #00000000, textcolor = sd1_col, size = sd1_size)

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds1_on  = input.bool(true, "Show weekly summary", group = "Dessert · Weekly summary", tooltip = "A plain summary of the current trading week: where it opened, how far price has moved since, how wide the week's range is, and whereabouts in that range price is sitting now.")
ds1_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Weekly table text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Weekly summary")
ds1_pos = input.string("Bottom right", "Weekly table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Weekly summary")

[ds1_o, ds1_h, ds1_l, ds1_c, ds1_po, ds1_pc] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [open, high, low, close, open[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

ds1_chg   = ds1_o > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_c - ds1_o) / ds1_o : 0.0
ds1_rng   = ds1_h - ds1_l
ds1_inr   = ds1_rng > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_c - ds1_l) / ds1_rng : 0.0
ds1_pchg  = ds1_po > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_pc - ds1_po) / ds1_po : 0.0
ds1_where_in = ds1_inr >= 70 ? "near the high" : ds1_inr <= 30 ? "near the low" : "mid range"
ds1_sign(v) =>
    (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#.##") + "%"

ds1_size = ds1_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds1_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds1_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large
ds1_where = ds1_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds1_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds1_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table ds1_t = table.new(ds1_where, 2, 6, border_width = 0)
ds1_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(ds1_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds1_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds1_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(ds1_t, 0, 0, "THIS WEEK", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds1_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    ds1_row(1, "Opened at",        str.tostring(ds1_o, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(2, "Moved since open", ds1_sign(ds1_chg), ds1_chg >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050)
    ds1_row(3, "Week's range",     str.tostring(ds1_rng, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(4, "Price sitting",    str.tostring(ds1_inr, "#") + "% up, " + ds1_where_in, #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(5, "Last week ended",  ds1_sign(ds1_pchg), ds1_pchg >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050)
